name: "Shared Sight" Comment Riddle Event
description: The "Shared Sight" event has begun~ Give your answers to where the little animals are hiding! From now until August 18, you can either post "screenshots of suitable hiding places for small animals in the game" as a Questioner or "places where small animals are located" as an Answerer. As a reward, you will receive a new background image for your profile page and the chance to win Primogems ×100! At the same time, we encourage everyone to like posts that show creative hiding spots in their images. The top 10 Travelers with the most Likes will get a bonus piece of merchandise!
